title: Gatchalian: Amendments on P7.2-T budget bill set on Dec. 4

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Saturday said that the proposed P7.2-trillion budget bill for 2027 will enter its period of amendments in the Senate on Friday, December 4, after the upper chamber wrapped up its plenary deliberations on the proposed budget for next year. The Senate began its marathon debates on the proposed budget last Monday, November 23, and concluded them early Saturday, November 28. “So magkakaroon kami ng period of amendments on Friday at iku-close na on second reading para ma-review ng mga senators natin over the weekend yung budget,” Gatchalian said in an interview with DWIZ.
